messages:
maria_chen: Escalation from Acme: after rotating a deployer service key, their project admins lost edit/create-key rights in the console; buttons are greyed out and API calls to /v1/projects/acme-prod/* return 403. Customer is blocked on deploy.
support-bot: Opened ticket SUP-13012, attaching customer repro and logs.
acme_oncall: Confirming we rotated the key at 2025-02-03T11:12:08Z (via our CI). UI stopped working ~11:13.
alex_kim: Can you share the service identity string and a sample 403 from our logs?
maria_chen: service id: svc/acme-deployer. Log snippet:
```
[2025-02-03T11:13:27Z] req=def456 user=svc/acme-deployer endpoint=/v1/projects/acme-prod/keys status=403 err="missing_project_admin_role"
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_YYYY...
```
ops_tony: Initial hypothesis: key rotation created a new principal_subject (subject claim changed). RoleBindings reference the old principal id so effective privileges drop until auth-reconcile runs. Run this to inspect: 
```
rictl iam inspect --project acme-prod --member "service:svc/acme-deployer"
```
Look for: principal_subject, attached_roles, last_reconciled_at.
support-bot: Queued auth-reconcile for acme-prod (job=auth-9911) at 2025-02-03T11:15:05Z.
maria_chen: rictl output shows:
```
principal_subject: svc-acme-deployer.rot1
attached_roles: []
last_reconciled_at: 2025-02-03T11:12:12Z
```
sre_jen: yep, subject changed (note the .rot1 suffix). Bindings still point to svc/acme-deployer (no suffix). Two options: quick unblock or reconcile. Quick unblock (applies emergency grant):
```
rictl iam grant --project acme-prod --member "service:svc-acme-deployer.rot1" --role project/admin --reason "emergency grant after key rotation"
```
Proper reconcile: ensure auth-reconcile maps legacy aliases to new subject and rehydrate rolebindings; also root-cause why reconcile didn't finish fast.
ops_tony: investigating reconcile backlog: there was a large SCIM sync from Acme starting 2025-02-03T10:50:00Z (7.2k changes). Our auth-reconcile worker pool hit the throttle ceiling and didn't scale fast enough; backlog delayed reconciliation by ~20m. Actions: clear the specific queue for acme-prod, rerun job auth-9911, temporarily bump reconcile workers for 30m.
alex_kim: did you apply the emergency grant? Customer update? :eyes: 
maria_chen: emergency grant applied at 11:18Z. Customer reports console actions restored at 11:22Z. I then re-ran job auth-9911; post-run inspect:
```
principal_subject: svc-acme-deployer.rot1
attached_roles: [project/admin]
last_reconciled_at: 2025-02-03T11:25:40Z
```
Issue resolved for now.
sre_jen: RCA summary for SUP-13012: key rotation changed service principal subject (suffix added) + auth-reconcile queue backlog due to a large SCIM import + autoscale throttle prevented quick reconciliation => transient loss of project admin actions. Mitigations applied: emergency grant, forced re-run of auth-reconcile, increased ephemeral workers.
ops_tony: infra next steps: PR to relax reconcile autoscale throttle and add a per-project fastpath when a key rotation event is detected. Also add a queue-monitor alert when reconcile latency > 30s for any project.
alex_kim: support KB: "Admins lose console perms after service key rotation". Short triage steps: 1) run rictl iam inspect, 2) if principal_subject differs, apply emergency grant, 3) re-run auth-reconcile, 4) clear queue / bump workers. Keep KB wording simple for CS.
maria_chen: emailed Acme with timeline and steps we took. Keeping ticket open until infra PR merges. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sre_jen: attaching auth-reconcile trace and job timeline to SUP-13012 for the postmortem.
maria_chen: marking thread resolved, will reopen if regression observed.
